notes.subject: פלדות
notes.rationale: פלדה occurs only here in the Tanakh; meaning 'steel/iron fittings' inferred from context.

notes.subject: והברשים הרעלו
notes.rationale: Read as 'the cypress-spears are brandished' (JPS/ASV); KJV takes the trees themselves 'terribly shaken'.

notes.subject: red klos
notes.rationale: Verse is a colour inventory — red shields, scarlet warriors, flashing steel — describing the attacking army.

translation: Ol sen bilong ol strongpela man bilong em i kamap red, ol man bilong pait i putim red klos; ol reket i gat paia bilong ol pas ailan long dei bilong ol i redim ol, na ol spia bilong diwai prais ol i braundism.

tokens.gloss: na ol spia bilong diwai prais
